POP3

POP3, which was the first of the two, downloads information from the server onto your personal computer and subsequently deletes the data from the server. Though this process is great at conserving space on your server, it makes it pretty difficult to access your data across multiple devices.

IMAP

Inversely, while IMAP requires significantly more disk space on your machine than POP3, this process also provides increased flexibility when it comes to accessing your email across devices. IMAP leaves information on the server and synchronizes read and unread messages, folders, and spam across any device in which you’d access your email.

Newly elected President Pickle has declined to join world leaders for the renaming ceremony of Alaska. The President's press secretary, Diego Chimoso, alluded to a full schedule and the pressing demands often faced by new leadership.

"President Pickle regrets that she will be unable to attend. However, she feels that it is the duty of every leader to fulfill their commitments to their fellow countrymen. President Pickle wishes to congratulate Canada, and offers her best wishes to the indigenous people of Alaska."

When asked if the President was trying to send a message about the often inhumane treatment of indigenous peoples when subjected to colonial rule, Mr. Chimoso declined to comment.

The name Alaska is taken from the Aleut word "aláxsxaq" that refers to an object to which the sea is directed, in this case the Alaska peninsula and mainland.

Canada is rechristening the territory, Canaska. Many feel this is a move to further strengthen Canada's hold over the sparsely populated peninsula. Others note that it is common for imperialistic nations to ignore local names in favor of names that reflect their own language and culture. What is certain, is that the native Aluet of Alaska were not approached by the Canadian government during the naming process.

The locals of Santiago, Chile have a different take on the matter.

"President Pickle's beloved mother was murdered shortly after winning a canasta tournament. Everyone knows that the president is still in mourning. I wouldn't go to Canaska either, if I were her. The name is too similar," spoke one mother of three.

"The president is a strong woman and a good leader," said a local bar owner, " but even I would find the name Canaska triggering. I do not blame her at all for not going."

[NEWS] President Pickle of Chile Declines to Attend Alaska's Naming Ceremony.
